item.subject: science
item.stem:
Ravi looked at a drop of pond water under a microscope in his school laboratory in Patna. He saw a tiny Amoeba moving about, feeding and reproducing, all on its own.
Ravi said, "It has only one cell, so it cannot be a complete living organism."
Which statement about the Amoeba is correct?

options.A: It is a complete living organism because one cell carries out all the functions needed for survival.
options.B: It is not a living organism because all living organisms are made of many cells.
options.C: It is alive only when it joins with other Amoeba cells to form a group.
options.D: It is a complete organism only because it lives in pond water.
